name: USPP032574P3
description: United States plant patent cited by the rights holder as covering the blueberry selection 'BB05-259MI-15', marketed as Medallion. The patent number and the code-to-name mapping come from the rights holder's own variety list; the patent document itself was not fetched, so the grant date is not recorded.
